sans.explanation: A red-flag symptom was recorded. Per the mission brief's decision tiers (Table 2), this escalates to Urgent independent of any probability calculation, which is not performed here. NOTE: this rule is 'sticky' - any red flag anywhere in history keeps every later day's assessment Urgent too (see _any_red_flag), since no human-approved resolution/reset/clearance policy currently exists. This is a deliberate conservative default, not an oversight - see handoff/research_lead/DECISIONS_NEEDED_NOW.md.
